name: Apple Developer
symbol: Download blocking for 18+ apps in Australia, Brazil, Singapore
title: Apple Developer: Download blocking for 18+ apps in Australia, Brazil, Singapore (behavior change)
summary: Starting February 24, 2026, Apple will block users in Australia, Brazil, and Singapore from downloading apps rated 18+ unless they have been confirmed to be adults through reasonable methods
replacement: Confirm users are adults through reasonable methods; the Declared Age Range API provides a signal about a user's age

name: Apple Developer
symbol: Apple Developer Program License Agreement update in Japan
title: Apple Developer: Apple Developer Program License Agreement update in Japan (configuration change)
summary: By March 17, 2026, all current members of the Apple Developer Program will need to agree to the latest update to the Apple Developer Program License Agreement, which includes new terms that allow for these options in Japan
replacement: Agree to the latest update to the Apple Developer Program License Agreement

name: Apple Developer
symbol: Minimum SDK for apps uploaded to App Store Connect
title: Apple Developer: Minimum SDK for apps uploaded to App Store Connect (configuration change)
summary: Starting April 28, 2026, apps and games uploaded to App Store Connect need to meet the following minimum requirements: iOS and iPadOS apps must be built with the iOS 26 & iPadOS 26 SDK or later
replacement: Build iOS and iPadOS apps with the iOS 26 & iPadOS 26 SDK or later, tvOS apps with the tvOS 26 SDK or later, visionOS apps with the visionOS 26 SDK or later, and watchOS apps with the watchOS 26 SDK or later.

name: Apple Developer
symbol: Texas age assurance and parental consent rules
title: Apple Developer: Texas age assurance and parental consent rules (behavior change)
summary: These changes will go into effect starting June 4, 2026
replacement: Use the Declared Age Range API for age category data, the Significant Change API under PermissionKit for significant changes, the new age rating property in StoreKit, and the App Store server notification for consent withdrawal.

name: Apple Developer
symbol: Apple Developer Program License Agreement update for Brazil
title: Apple Developer: Apple Developer Program License Agreement update for Brazil (configuration change)
summary: By July 6, 2026, all current members of the Apple Developer Program will need to agree to the latest update to the Apple Developer Program License Agreement, which includes new terms that allow for these options in Brazil
replacement: Agree to the latest update to the Apple Developer Program License Agreement

name: Apple Developer
title: Apple Developer: Age rating questionnaire content descriptors (configuration change)
summary: All apps must have these declarations completed by January 12, 2027

name: Apple Developer
symbol: Original Developer ID Certification Authority (Sub-CA) certificates
title: Apple Developer: Original Developer ID Certification Authority (Sub-CA) certificates removed
summary: The original Developer ID Certification Authority (Sub-CA) expires on February 1, 2027. Certificates issued by this authority will stop working on that date
replacement: Generate a replacement certificate from Developer ID Certification Authority (G2), selecting G2 Sub-CA as the Developer ID Certificate Intermediary.

name: Apple Developer
symbol: Installer packages signed with affected Developer ID certificates
title: Apple Developer: Installer packages signed with affected Developer ID certificates (behavior change)
summary: Starting February 1, 2027, .pkg files signed with an affected certificate will no longer install
replacement: Re-sign all packages with your new certificate before this date.
